
There has to be a better way to say this than ''kurmitre''.

Although it does somewhat work to describe the dimension of the unit at a right angle to itself, generalizing this idea would lead to words like ''kursnidu'', and the concept of a second at a right angle to another second doesn't work so nicely.

Plus, even if it's justifiable, ''kurmitre'' certainly '''looks''' malglico.

How about {reltefmitre}?

Maybe ''pitmitre'' for square meter, ''calmitre'' for cubic meter.

----

The most standard answer we have so far is '''tretre'''.

Even '''ctotrectotre''' was suggested for ''hectare''.
